title: Non-Destructive, Real-Time Quality Determination of Ginseng Seeds Using a YOLO-GS Model
content: The lack of a rapid, non-destructive method for accurately determining ginseng seed quality remains a significant bottleneck for industrial-scale nursery production and quality control. The post-germination seeds are minuscule and exhibit subtle morphological variations, making automated determination particularly challenging. To address this, this study proposes YOLO-GS, an improved deep learning model based on YOLOv11n. YOLO-GS incorporates a suite of dedicated attention-enhanced modules (including SELP, CPCA, AssemFormer, and C2PSA_CloFormerAttnConv) that work synergistically to significantly enhance the network's ability to capture fine-grained features and subtle defects. On a self-built ginseng seed dataset, YOLO-GS achieves a precision of 96.7%, an mAP@0.5 of 97.7%, and an F1-Score of 96.5%, outperforming the baseline YOLOv11n with minimal computational overhead (4.26 M parameters, 14.1 GFLOPs). When deployed on a Jetson edge device, the model achieves an inference speed of 0.6 ms per image. This demonstrates its strong potential for enabling large-scale, automated sorting systems based on real-time quality determination, thereby enhancing efficiency and standardization in ginseng seed nursery production.
